candidates.fit_target: all 90 case-pass critical-path medians; equal row weight; no removed trials or passes
candidates.proposed_median_rule: Every leave-one-pass-out prediction must have <=5% relative error against that held-out case-pass median; all fits require positive intercept and slope. Retain all trial tails. This is median qualification, not per-trial p90 fidelity.
candidates.proposed_tail_check: For P2 exact bytes/pairs/inflight only, every observed completion must be positive and below each subsequent step-start gap. Finite samples are not a universal serving tail bound.

adoption_domain.outside_domain: fail qualification; no cross-hardware substitution or extrapolation

candidates.runtime_limit: Existing predictor is bytes-only and cannot enforce concurrency/domain. External preflight/event census must reject out-of-domain cases; generalized table/batch use requires an interface change.
candidates.proposed_trial_rule: Separately evaluate median<=5%, p90<=10% of absolute relative trial errors per held-out case/pass; NOT_ADOPTED; retain FAILs.

empirical_bound.definition: Positive observed batch completions strictly below every later polling start; use sample maximum without dividing by inflight.
empirical_bound.rule: Every case/pass/trial must be below the scale-specific earliest step. P2 use admits exact bytes=46103040,pairs=8,inflight=1 only. Full-grid diagnostics remain reported.
empirical_bound.domain: Retained P2 windows and standalone H200 sample only; no guaranteed future serving-tail coverage
empirical_bound.cost: 0 new GPUh; CPU window scan; additional serving-tail evidence needed for universal guarantee

concurrency_point.definition: Pooled critical-path median for each exact (bytes/request,pairs,inflight); 6143/6144 combine at the same byte coordinate; every original prompt/pass remains separately validated.
concurrency_point.rule: Leave each pass out; train point on other two passes; <=5% error against each held-out case-pass median. Separately report unadopted per-trial median5/p90 10% rule.
concurrency_point.domain: Exact measured coordinates only; fail on every other value, no interpolation. n>1 values measure wait-all batch completion, not individual request completion.
concurrency_point.cost: 0 new GPUh; new predictor context/table interface requires separate source approval. Fresh replays if binding changes or any completion can move

physical_affine.definition: OLS all90 full-batch medians vs total bytes/reader; positive intercept and slope, no clamp. P2 config uses n=1 only.
physical_affine.rule: Every two-pass training fit physical; every held-out case-pass median <=5% error; every observed P2-coordinate trial below every possible-post gap. Trial median5/p90 10% separately FAIL.
physical_affine.domain: Approval restricted to retained P2 exact byte/pair/n=1 coordinates; external census rejects other workloads. No inferred hardware/fabric/unseen-geometry fidelity.
physical_affine.cost: 0 new GPUh; analysis and external domain check; no fresh replay under proven no-motion. General n>1 use needs interface/source work

replay_windows.name: p2_32_b29
replay_windows.concurrency_inference: Each physical READ is a positive subinterval of its transfer-ledger window. Windows do not overlap even across DP lanes; TP8 is implicit, eight paired READs per logical request.
replay_windows.proof: All prices are strictly positive and below the first later step for every possible post. The same step finds each READ; the same output reports it. No zero-duration decode forward can introduce an idle wire-end wake. By induction through the deterministic DES, changing only the wire price cannot move a READ release or later event.
